The amount shown is indicative of the amount you may be able to use in your {productName} account for this goal. The amount shown may not be what is actually available because:
  • some transactions may not have updated the amount shown (e.g.reversals)
  • some transactions may have updated the amount shown but are not yet fully processed (e.g. pending transactions), and/or
  • we may not process transactions at the time, on the day or in the order that they are made.
If you proceed with a transaction when there may be insufficient funds, your account may go overdrawn or the transaction may be declined.
